decisions.reason: As a low-cost Magento-related add-on tightly linked to the firm's shop and hosting customer base, it keeps upside open without enough negative evidence yet to justify abandonment.
The responsive website template is close to the core offer and likely inexpensive to keep available, so management would wait for more market feedback before exiting.
Premium customer support directly reinforces the firm's agency-focused service differentiation and relies on existing support capabilities, making withdrawal unlikely.
The software version management tool builds on the firm's technical know-how and could deepen customer retention, so its option value remains attractive.

Although the data-processing-contract tool is more distant from the core business and may need ongoing updates, it is still a relatively low-cost digital option connected to customer compliance needs, so management would keep it under close review.
